data.cultural_impact: The name Ghayyas carries a strong cultural connotation that evokes images of perseverance, determination, and hard work. In Islamic tradition, individuals are encouraged to strive for personal growth, excellence, and success in this life. The name Ghayyas would serve as an inspiration for its bearer to dedicate themselves towards their goals with unwavering commitment.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ghayyas reflects the concept of Tasawwuf or Sufism, which emphasis the importance of self-development, inner growth, and ascent towards God. The із (zh) at the end of the name alludes to the Persian term 'zahid', meaning ascetic or abstemious. Hence, Ghayyas can also be interpreted as someone who is hungry for spiritual enlightenment and is willing to go to great lengths in their quest for nearness to Allah.
